title.en: Automating Multi-Outlet Restaurant Kitchen Orders and Inventory Tracking
title.id: Otomasi Pesanan Dapur & Pelacakan Inventaris Restoran Multi-Outlet

desc.en: How we integrated offline POS thermal printers with cloud inventory databases, eliminating $2,400 monthly waste across 4 outlets.
desc.id: Integrasi printer thermal kasir lokal dengan database cloud inventaris, menghemat pemborosan bahan baku senilai Rp 36 juta per bulan.

body.en:
How we integrated offline POS thermal printers with cloud inventory databases, eliminating $2,400 monthly waste across 4 outlets.

The Island of Disconnected Kitchen Systems

In many casual dining chains in Jakarta, kitchen staff print tickets from offline desktop POS systems while raw ingredient inventory is recorded manually at night on paper clipboards. Discrepancies between sold items and stock wastage averaged 14%.

10xexecution speed acceleration
94%reduction in manual data entry errors
sub-50msend-to-end processing latency

Raw ESC/POS Byte Interception on the LAN

Instead of ripping out existing hardware, we deployed lightweight Raspberry Pi print spoolers on the local network. By reading raw ESC/POS command bytes sent to Epson thermal printers, the agent decodes order tickets in real-time.

Real-Time Bill of Materials (BOM) Depletion

Every time a tenderized steak or coffee order prints in the kitchen, the exact gram-level recipe BOM is deducted from central Postgres inventory tables via encrypted WebSocket transactions.

Real-Time Hospitality Integration Gateway
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, BackgroundTasks
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
import httpx

app = FastAPI()

class ReservationEvent(BaseModel):
    booking_id: str
    property_code: str
    guest_name: str
    phone_number: str
    room_number: str

@app.post("/api/v1/pms/sync")
async def sync_property_event(event: ReservationEvent, bg_tasks: BackgroundTasks):
    bg_tasks.add_task(dispatch_guest_precheckin, event)
    return {"status": "accepted", "id": event.booking_id}

Automated Supplier Reordering Logic

When dairy or meat supplies breach dynamic safety thresholds calculated against upcoming weekend reservation volume, draft Purchase Orders are generated and sent to supplier WhatsApp groups automatically.
